The '''Battle of Chandaar''' was fought between the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] of [[Xer VIII|Xer]] and the [[Kingdom of Cron]] in the [[Pre-Republic era]], at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandaar]].

When the pirate Xer began rapid expansion of the [[Kingdom of Argai]] within the Kingdom of Cron, [[King of Cron]] [[Ferece]] summoned Xer to [[Chandaar]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Kingdom of Cron. Ferece tried to persuade Xer give an oath of fealty, in return for a number of noble titles, and Xer promised to return in a month with a suitable tribute. However, he [[Battle of Duinarbulon|smashed]] a Cronese battlegroup at [[Duinarbulon]], and led an attack on Chandaar. Xer stormed the Cronese capital, causing Ferece and his courtiers to flee. In the absence of Ferece, Xer installed himself as the new [[King/Legends|King]] of Cron and launched several campaings to expand his territory in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].<ref name="Xim Week" />
